about.title: ABOUT GULF ESTATES
about.description: Gulf Estates is a premier real estate agency in Dubai, specializing in luxury properties, off-plan investments, and high-return opportunities in the UAE’s most exclusive communities. Whether you’re buying, selling, or renting, we provide access to handpicked villas, apartments, and penthouses in iconic areas like Downtown Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Business Bay.

off-plan.title: THE LEADING
off-plan.p1: Dubai’s real estate market continues to thrive, with off-plan properties offering some of the most rewarding investment opportunities. Buying under-construction real estate not only allows you to secure premium units at launch prices, but also opens the door to flexible payment plans and strong capital appreciation.
off-plan.p2: At Gulf Estates, we curate a selection of the most sought-after off-plan developments from leading developers like Aldar, Ellington, Emaar, DAMAC, and Sobha. Whether you're investing for future rental income or long-term gains, Dubai’s new communities are designed to deliver on value, lifestyle, and return.
off-plan.p3: Start your journey with tomorrow’s most iconic addresses.

goldenVisa.title: UAE
goldenVisa.description: The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residence visa for eligible Real Estate investors, entrepreneurs, exceptional talents, outstanding students and graduates, humanitarian pioneers and frontline heroes. It allows eligible residents to live, work or study in the UAE with greater long-term stability.
benefits: 5- or 10-year renewable residence, depending on the category.
Greater flexibility when staying outside the UAE.
Ability to sponsor eligible family members, including spouse and children.
A long-term residency option for investors, professionals, entrepreneurs and exceptional talents.

businessSetup.title: Start Your
businessSetup.description: The UAE offers a streamlined process for establishing businesses across all seven emirates. Investors can set up a company through mainland economic departments, free zones, or online services such as the Basher platform.
businessSetup.helpDescription: Our team can help you understand the available company setup options, identify a suitable business structure and guide you through the next steps.
